baseline_models.mechanism: Arrival, community, and visible bearing form a spatial sequence: Mary crosses into her people's presence with the carried body exposed as the scene's public object.

activation_trace.role: Coming and arrival supply the crossing into public presence.
The people-group supplies the receiving communal audience and makes the encounter social.
The visibly lifted load supplies the inspectable body around which the encounter forms.

changed_reading.before: Mary simply returns while holding the child.
changed_reading.after: The syntax stages a public presentation: arrival deposits a visible carried body before a communal audience.

baseline_models.mechanism: The carrying root can hold an exterior load, interior pregnancy, and the carried child's uncertain lineage; one visible action therefore bears physical and genealogical weight at once.

activation_trace.role: Visible carrying supplies the immediate exterior burden.
Interior pregnancy supplies the bodily history folded into the exterior carrying.
The carried child of uncertain lineage supplies the social burden latent in what is borne.

changed_reading.after: Her exterior carrying exposes completed interior carrying and carries a lineage-question into the group.

baseline_models.mechanism: Collective speech turns what was brought into a circulating social classification, while the range of فري holds astonishment, rupture, and fabrication together.

activation_trace.role: Speech spreading among people supplies the collective circulation of the verdict.
Bringing something into presence supplies the alleged act assigned to Mary.
A knowable, reportable thing supplies the object into which the event is verbally compressed.
Fabricated falsehood supplies the charge's accusatory edge.
An astonishing, enormous affair supplies the crowd's shock and magnitude judgment.

changed_reading.before: The people merely exclaim that Mary has done something shocking.
changed_reading.after: Their plural utterance manufactures a public charge, leaving 'the thing' poised between astonishing event and alleged fabrication.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier withdrawal to a side and erection of a barrier make the focus arrival a reversal from protected separation to maximal communal exposure.

activation_trace.role: Withdrawal to a side supplies the initial vector away from collective view.
A screening barrier supplies the protected boundary later crossed.
Arrival supplies the return across that boundary.
Visible bearing supplies the exposed object that makes the return consequential.

structural_cues: 19:16-17 places Mary apart from her family behind a barrier; 19:27 places her and the carried child before her people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withdrawal, barrier, return, and visible carrying; I infer a concealment-to-exposure arrow, while the barrier may alternatively mark only temporary privacy.

changed_reading.before: The arrival begins a new public scene.
changed_reading.after: The arrival is the deliberate reversal of the scene's spatial protections: what was secluded is now carried into collective sight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated حمل shifts from bearing him inwardly before withdrawal to bearing him outwardly before the people, converting bodily continuity into public and genealogical exposure.

activation_trace.role: Pregnancy as an interior load supplies the first phase of the repeated carrying.
Withdrawal to a side supplies the private space in which that load remains socially unseen.
Exterior carrying supplies the visible second phase brought before the group.
The carried child with uncertain lineage supplies the social question attached to the bodily transition.

structural_cues: 19:22 and 19:27 repeat حمل with the same carried referent but reverse inner bearing and secluded movement into outer bearing and communal arrival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated carrying, withdrawal, and return; I infer that the root repetition compresses gestation into presentation, while it may alternatively serve only as narrative continuity.

changed_reading.before: The focus carrying is an isolated physical gesture.
changed_reading.after: It is the public face of the earlier pregnancy: the inward load has become an outward, genealogically charged load.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier causative arrival is labor's coercion, but the crowd's second-person جئت recodes the resulting arrival as Mary's own chosen production of an offense.

activation_trace.role: Compulsion and forcing supply the agency structure of labor bringing Mary to the trunk.
A pregnant body's disturbance in labor supplies the force that drives the earlier movement.
Bringing a thing into presence supplies the agency the crowd directly assigns to Mary.
The enormous astonishing affair supplies the adverse classification attached to that assigned agency.

structural_cues: The sequence contrasts 19:23 أَجَاءَهَا, with labor as grammatical driver, and 19:27 جِئْتِ, with Mary addressed as agent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies compelled movement and later second-person blame; I infer that the crowd suppresses the prior coercive chain, while their wording may alternatively judge only the result and not its cause.

changed_reading.before: The crowd accuses Mary of arriving with a shocking result.
changed_reading.after: Their wording retrospectively converts a labor-driven, compelled process into a voluntary act for which she can be blamed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mary's announced abstention from human speech creates an asymmetrical public encounter: she bears the visible referent while the group gains temporary control of its verbal framing.

activation_trace.role: The instruction to utter the vow supplies the explicit installation of a speech boundary.
Restraint of the tongue supplies Mary's active silence before the encounter.
The branch's bodily wound lets absent human conversation sharpen the injurious force of the words that replace it.
A saying circulating among people supplies the crowd's takeover of the public account.

structural_cues: 19:26 ends with a refusal to speak to any human that day; 19:27 immediately assigns plural speech to the people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vowed silence followed by collective speech; I infer that silence lets the group frame visible evidence without Mary's verbal defense, while the vow may alternatively be devotional without juridical intent.

changed_reading.before: Mary happens not to answer the crowd's accusation.
changed_reading.after: Her prior speech-fast structurally allocates the first public interpretation to the crowd, making their utterance a wound laid over silent visual evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next utterance inventories sisterhood, father, mother, and sexual transgression, resolving the focus people's reaction into a communal audit of lineage and inherited reputation.

activation_trace.role: The carried child whose lineage is questioned supplies the focus scene's latent genealogical problem.
Sibling kinship supplies the first coordinate in the community's family map.
Fatherhood and upbringing supply paternal reputation as evidence in the audit.
The mother as parent and nurturer supplies maternal reputation as a second inherited standard.
Sexual transgression supplies the specific offense inferred from the carried child.

structural_cues: The address after 19:27 moves through sister, father, and mother before naming sexual misconduct.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a family roll call and an offense term; I infer a lineage tribunal reconstructing an unseen cause from the visible child, while the sequence may alternatively be emphatic reproach rather than a formal audit.

changed_reading.before: Her people voice generic moral outrage.
changed_reading.after: They inspect the carried child through a kinship ledger, treating family reputation as evidence for a sexual and genealogical charge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mary's gesture redirects the crowd from speaking about the carried body to addressing it; the apparent evidence becomes a speaking bearer of report and counter-testimony.

activation_trace.role: Bearing a message or trust lets the physical carrying hold a communicative function latent in the child.
A bodily indication supplies Mary's nonverbal transfer of attention and response.
Intelligible speech connecting interlocutors supplies the crowd's initially impossible demand of the child.
Actual voiced saying supplies the child's reversal from spoken-about object to speaker.
A report that arrives and is conveyed supplies the testimonial content carried into the scene.

structural_cues: 19:29 redirects attention by gesture, asks how the child can be addressed, and 19:30 immediately gives him the next قَالَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gesture, challenged address, and the child's report; I infer an evidence-to-witness reversal that bears Mary's unspoken defense, while the speech may alternatively function only as self-identification.

changed_reading.before: Mary carries the mute exhibit on which the accusation rests.
changed_reading.after: She carries the scene's future counter-speaker: the alleged evidence becomes the bearer of the answering report.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later 'saying of truth' and explicit dispute turn the focus label of fabrication into a contest between utterances, allowing the accusation's own status to come under scrutiny.

activation_trace.role: A saying circulating among people supplies the socially dominant accusation.
Fabricated falsehood supplies the category the crowd projects onto Mary's act.
Truth fixed in correspondence with reality supplies the counter-standard for judging the sayings.
Making truth evident supplies the later disclosure that destabilizes the first public label.
Sharp verbal dispute supplies the arena in which competing sayings remain active.

structural_cues: The focus begins a collective saying that names fabrication; 19:34 names a saying of truth precisely where dispute persists.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accusation, truth-saying, and dispute; I infer that the fabrication label can rebound onto the accusers' report, while the later truth may only relativize rather than directly indict their exact words.

changed_reading.before: The crowd securely identifies Mary's deed as the fabricated or monstrous object.
changed_reading.after: Their label becomes one claimant in a speech contest: 'fabrication' may diagnose the public report as much as the event it names.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human collective speech names a brought 'thing' as outrageous, whereas the contextual sequence places things under completed decree and a saying that effects being; social classification is set against ontological production.

activation_trace.role: Voiced human saying supplies the act of publicly naming the event.
The thing as object of will supplies the hinge between a social object and an effected reality.
The astonishing affair supplies the human valuation imposed on what has appeared.
An accomplished and executed act supplies the prior causal status of the event.
Voiced saying in the creation formula supplies the contrastive speech whose function is effecting rather than accusing.
Coming into occurrence and presence supplies the result of that effecting speech.

structural_cues: 19:27 joins قَالُوا, شَيْئًا, and فَرِيًّا; 19:21 calls the matter accomplished, and 19:35 joins saying with كُن فَيَكُونُ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies communal naming, a willed thing, completed decree, and effecting speech; I infer a naming-versus-making contrast, while the creation formula may alternatively remain a general theological frame rather than a local answer.

changed_reading.before: The people define the reality of the event by calling it outrageous.
changed_reading.after: Their speech can classify but not cause the thing; the context relocates its reality under prior decree and effecting speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mary's coming before her people is mirrored by a later coming before 'us' at a scene of witness and decisive judgment, reversing who stands as examiner and who arrives to be examined.

activation_trace.role: Mary's arrival supplies the first movement into another party's judging presence.
The gathered people supply the provisional human audience that assumes judgment.
Presence with witnessing supplies the later scene in which claims become inspectable.
Their coming to 'us' supplies the mirrored arrival and reverses the direction of exposure.
Cutting judgment supplies the decisive tribunal beyond the people's provisional verdict.

structural_cues: 19:27 has Mary come before her people; 19:37-39 moves to a witnessed day when they come before 'us' and the matter is judged.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two arrivals and a later witnessed judgment; I infer a reversal of accuser and examined party, while the later arrival may alternatively broaden the horizon without targeting this crowd scene alone.

changed_reading.before: Mary's people occupy the stable position of judges when she comes to them.
changed_reading.after: Their tribunal is provisional: the arrival pattern turns, and those who inspect her will themselves arrive into witnessed judgment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the guilt and false-charge branches of جني are distant from the ripe-date surface in 19:25. It remains anchored through that immediate root cue and the focus pair of circulating speech plus fabricated charge; render it only as lexical activation or scene-level wordplay, not as the translation of جَنِيًّا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَالُوا۟ ... شَيْـًۭٔا فَرِيًّۭا after رُطَبًۭا جَنِيًّۭا

activation_trace.role: Taking harvested produce supplies the literal fruit scene immediately before the encounter.
Attributing guilt to an innocent person supplies an exploratory reversal from harvested fruit to harvested accusation.
A saying circulating among people supplies the social mechanism by which guilt is gathered and spread.
Fabricated falsehood supplies the possibility that the gathered charge is itself false.

changed_reading.before: The harvested dates and the crowd's accusation belong to unrelated phases.
changed_reading.after: The fruit harvest primes an exploratory social harvest of guilt, with the possibility that the public charge is what has been falsely gathered.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because cut-for-repair is not the ordinary force of فَرِيًّا here, and the جبر occurrence is the negated جَبَّارًا. It remains anchored in the focus branch and the adjacent filial and repair branch images; render it as a qualified material analogy in which rupture may enable rejoining, never as a lexical translation or as cancellation of the negation.

activation_trace.role: Cutting material for repair and stitching supplies a constructive possibility inside the scandal's rupture.
Filial connection and beneficence supply a relational direction toward the mother rather than away from her.
Repairing breakage supplies the cross-root material analogy that turns a cut toward restoration.

changed_reading.before: فَرِيّ marks only a shocking rupture in communal order.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the rupture can also be a cut made for rejoining: the child who opens the breach may carry a possible repair of relation.

strongest_changes: Repeated حمل turns gestation into a public and genealogically charged presentation.
The crowd's جئت recodes labor's compelled أَجَاءَهَا as a voluntary offense.
Vowed silence gives communal speech temporary control until the carried child becomes the counter-speaker.
The later arrival to witnessed judgment reverses the people's provisional tribunal.
summary.what_was_special: The ayah concentrates motion, burden, and speech: a hidden bodily event crosses into communal visibility and is instantly converted into a charge, while later context reassigns agency, testimony, and judgment.
remaining_uncertainties: How strongly the uncertain-lineage branch of حمل should govern the explicit genealogical reading rather than remain a lexical echo.
Whether the truth/fabrication reversal targets the crowd's exact utterance or only relativizes it within a wider speech contest.
The harvested-guilt and cut-for-repair readings are deliberate exploratory branch activations, not translations.
